value.rationale: PASS: The initiating social-pressure paper identifies alternating reciprocal biases on bipartite networks as the degenerate boundary where both endpoint Jacobians have critical Perron eigenvalue. The new result resolves that structurally motivated gap completely at the equilibrium level for every connected weighted bipartite graph, and at the trajectory level on every complete bipartite graph. The conserved ratio maps arbitrary heterogeneous initial opinions to an explicit stable point and reveals distinct exact collective versus within-part time scales, making an otherwise qualitative Lyapunov convergence result quantitatively predictive. It is neither a parameter substitution nor an arbitrary finite slice.
